properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-23, option (c) plus a "named, not read" marking: a source reuses evidence's grade and confidence to say how much support it gives, and a source named but not read never counts as citing
properties.rationale:
@ajs, 2026-10-23: "I agree with both", answering my recommendation: give a source a "named, not read" marking so it does not count as citing, and reuse the source grade evidence already carries (option (c)). Options (a), a taxonomy of source kinds, and (b), DOCUMENTS scoped to part of a record, stay CONSIDERED, not built.

What (c) asks:
- A source Artifact can carry the existing source grade (A–F) and credibility (1–6) from req:evidence-carries-its-source-grade-and-confidence-and-is-not-intent. A citation it documents reads no stronger than that grade allows.
- A source can be marked named but not read. A DOCUMENTS edge from it does not take a claim off uncited_premises, and what rests on it reads as uncited.

Measured cause: the Navier–Stokes map rung, finding (c) (reflow2:fact:the-navier-stokes-map-rung-ran-on-0-90-0-and-a-claim-reads-as-a-claim-but-reflow2-has-no-claimed-reading-2026-10-22), plus the heat rung's homework statement and Wikipedia paraphrase reading "checked". Built in PR A2. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
